# VibeRaven

> Production readiness for AI-built apps. Agent Context + Production Gate.

VibeRaven runs inside Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Copilot, or any agent that can run terminal commands. It scans repo evidence, separates repo-code fixes from provider actions, writes `.viberaven/` artifacts, and gives the agent the next safe production step.

Native agent chat remains the cockpit. VibeRaven makes normal chat output behave like an action surface by rendering stable IDs, focused targets, copy blocks, command blocks, verify commands, and resume prompts.

## Canonical Commands

```bash
npx -y viberaven preview --agent-mode
npx -y viberaven preview --json
npx -y viberaven init --agents all
npx -y viberaven doctor --agents
npx -y viberaven --agent-mode
npx -y viberaven actions
npx -y viberaven verify --action VR-A1
npx -y viberaven --verify
npx -y viberaven --strict
npx -y viberaven audit --vercel-supabase
```

Use `preview` for free demos and screenshots. Use `--agent-mode` for real repo scans.

## Agent Loop

Read `.viberaven/actions.json`, `.viberaven/agent-tasklist.md`, `.viberaven/gate-result.json`, and `.viberaven/context-map.json`. Fix one launch gap, verify once per batch, and keep operating until the gate is clear or a provider/user blocker remains.

Do not claim production-ready while `gate.status` is not `clear`.

## Output Safety

Never render secrets, tokens, raw env values, cookies, service-role keys, or absolute local paths. File targets must be repo-relative. Provider links must be focused and useful, not generic dashboard spam.
